title: Connected devices
hint: Every screen or browser running the board checks in each minute. Disconnecting signs the device out at once and ends its session.
confirmRevoke: Disconnect “{name}”? It signs out immediately and needs a new sign-in.
confirmRevokeSelf: This is the device you are using now. Disconnecting signs you out. Continue?
confirmDelete: Delete the record for “{name}”? If the device is still open it will register again.
empty: No devices yet. Open the board on any screen and it appears here within a minute.
demoHint: The demo account is view-only — disconnecting is for admins.
alertsTitle: Email me when a screen goes quiet
alertsHint: Watched screens only. If one stops reporting for longer than this, you get an email — and another when it comes back. One email per outage, not every five minutes.
